motion_state: run (deliberate run state at MOVE_SPEED 140; NOT a walk)
status: UNAPPROVED / NONRUNTIME test-only single-direction motion pilot; Codex / creator visual review pending; motion not approved; not a production sprite or runtime replacement
approved_scope_unchanged: selout v8 SOUTH IDLE static frame and the 48 logical px display scale only

display.body_draw_offset: none: the body is drawn at the logical position
display.stance_boot: drawn at the window row fixed on landing; its leg is re-stacked from v8 rows each tick

shadow.drawn: as a separate test-only sprite UNDER the character, also under the v8 idle (two v8-spot ellipses), so it never pops at the stop; the character PNGs contain no shadow texels

rig.head_rule: v8 rows <= 28, rows 29..33 x <= 40, chin row 34 x 32..37, neck row 35 x 34..35: stays steady
rig.leg_rule: rows hip(61+bob) .. boot top-1 = thigh + v8 knee band (whole) + shin, thigh/shin rows by nearest whole-row pick in proportion to v8's lengths; knee lean kin texels inward, thigh lean grows with t^2, shin returns to 0 at the boot; pinhole fill as v01; neck / shoulder seam fill (single closed holes -> ink) when the torso is shifted

gait.zero_slip_walk_needs: no flight requires stance_px >= stride_px / 2, i.e. a stride <= 44 px here: about 12.7 steps/s at 140 logical px/s, so this is a run, not a walk

stop.rule: on the release tick the hero stops (runtime unchanged).  1) every boot in the air flies to its v8 spot and lands (lift <= 2, lift >= 1 until touchdown); 2) then each planted boot that is not on its v8 spot does one low shuffle step (lift 1 for an offset <= 3 rows, else 2) to it, rearmost first; a planted boot never moves while planted; at most one boot changes its view or touches down per tick (the other holds one tick); 3) weight shift: while one boot moves, the torso shifts 1 texel toward the boot that carries the weight; after the last touchdown the body stays 1 row low (dip) for settle_ms, then the dip and the torso shift return on the same tick; both arms step one pose toward N per arm_step_ms on ticks where no boot changes; hair / cape lag hair_lag_ms and move at most one row / texel per tick; 4) the tick after the composite equals v8 (neutral state), the v8 PNG itself is shown.
stop.land_keys: [[0, o0, l0, view0, kin0], [500, rdiv(o0, 2), max(1, min(2, l0)), reach, 0], [1000, 0, 1, strike, 0]]; at u >= 1000 the boot is in contact on its spot (stance view for q = land_offset)

restart.rule: on a re-press the planted boot (if two: the one that landed LAST) stays in stance and keeps its window row; the gait phase is re-derived from its offset (q = land_offset - o); the other boot (if planted: lifted now; if in the air: kept where it is) gets a re-planned swing from its current offset / lift to land_offset at its next scheduled landing (the stride sync of 48 px is kept).  The leg that landed last is never the one that lifts first, so the next touchdown is always the other boot.  With both boots in the air the frozen phase resumes.  Arms ease to the gait pose one arm and one pose step per tick until they match it.
restart.replan_keys: [[0, o0, max(1, l0), toe if view0 is a stance view else view0, kin0], [500, rdiv(o0 + land_offset, 2), max(l0, hs), hang, 1], [800, land_offset - 1, max(1, rdiv(hs, 2)), reach, 0], [1000, land_offset, 1, strike, 0]]; hs = clamp(rdiv(3 * remaining_px, stride_px - stance_px), replan_lift_min, replan_lift_max)

bounds.collision: runtime collision is the hero foot point (CityNavigation / annex clamps), unchanged; the pilot is display-only and never feeds back into movement

size_cost.runtime_lookup: per tick: phase = travelled window px mod stride; feet from the stance roll / swing keys; stop and re-press by the rules above; no sub-pixel stop table
